rows.grounds: locative of compound ṣoḍaśa-āra indicating the sixteen-petaled enclosure
compound pūrva-ādi indicating sequence starting from the eastern direction
instrumental plural of compound śrī-pātra-amṛta-bindu denoting drops of nectar from the sacred vessel

items.question: Where and with what substance does the ritual sequence proceed in the sixteen-petaled enclosure?
premises: The ritual locus is the sixteen-spoked enclosure.
The sequence begins from the eastern direction.
Drops of nectar from the auspicious vessel are the employed substance.
items.inference: The ritual sequence in the sixteen-petaled enclosure proceeds eastward using nectar drops from the auspicious vessel.
uncertainties: The governing verb is supplied from context and not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: But in the sixteen-petaled enclosure, beginning from the east, it is done with drops of nectar from the auspicious vessel.
